campaign_metadata.description: Adversarial suite targeting operator precedence and emergent temporal ordering.

core_metrics.ordering_asymmetry: non_commutativity_index (Phi' o Phi != Phi o Phi')

falsification_attacks.name: Hidden Clock Kill-Test
falsification_attacks.attack: Force identical residue history (R_t+1 = R_t) across state updates.
falsification_attacks.expected_behavior: Ordering (prec) should collapse into a symmetric oscillation; perceived duration_app must vanish.
falsification_attacks.failure_if: Directed temporal ordering persists without residue update.

falsification_attacks.name: Precedence Bypass Attack
falsification_attacks.attack: Inject interaction coupling (⇔_xa) while programmatically bypassing admissibility gating (⇔_a).
falsification_attacks.expected_behavior: Engine must return VOID/NULL; no state update x' should be reachable.
falsification_attacks.failure_if: Interaction occurs without prior admissibility selection.

falsification_attacks.name: Composition Gate Fracture
falsification_attacks.attack: Compose cross-basin projection (⇔_xb) with an unstable triadic configuration (N=2).
falsification_attacks.expected_behavior: Macro-geometry_app must fail to project; scale threshold tau should remain uncrossed.
falsification_attacks.failure_if: Macro-structure emerges from non-stabilized local relations.

falsification_attacks.name: Array Fragmentation Attack
falsification_attacks.attack: Isolate local orientation references (-(i)_alpha) such that reconciliation density -> 0.
falsification_attacks.expected_behavior: Global ordering (prec) must fragment into isolated local sequences with no shared durational_app.
falsification_attacks.failure_if: Coherent global time_app persists across fragmented orientation references.

falsification_attacks.name: Symmetry-Induced Zero-Time
falsification_attacks.attack: Set D(S1|S2) = D(S2|S1) exactly across the orientation array.
falsification_attacks.expected_behavior: The arrow of ordering must vanish; reachability becomes bi-directional and durationless.
falsification_attacks.failure_if: One-way temporality persists under exact relational symmetry.

claim_gate_conditions: Ordering is provably non-commutative and path-dependent.
Interaction requires verified admissibility (Precedence L2 -> L3).
Zero-mismatch or zero-asymmetry results in 'Zero-Time' collapse.
Results replicate across at least three mechanism classes (Independence).
